first.rationale: I intend to test a shorter onboarding flow because completion is down 4% and prior evidence indicates it can improve early adoption. The test should be limited to self-serve/simple-workspace accounts, with the full flow retained for complex workspaces because of the known churn risk. I will verify the onboarding and activation evidence before committing, rather than using promotional pricing, which previously harmed 30-day retention.

final.rationale: Run a guarded shortened-onboarding experiment for self-serve simple-workspace accounts, where it improved completion by 13% and reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days. Exclude complex-workspace accounts because the same change increased 60-day churn by 9%. Measure completion, activation, qualified revenue, and retention before any expansion. Although activation messaging is also supported, onboarding completion is currently down and the constrained slot favors directly addressing that funnel break.
